description: Defines data structures and classes related to codeblock metadata, segments, and segmentation configuration for LDPC coding in a communication system.

classes.name: codeblock_metadata
classes.description: Holds parameters describing a codeblock, including common transport block parameters and specific codeblock parameters.

classes.name: described_segment
classes.description: Represents an LDPC segment or codeblock with associated metadata and data storage.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Returns a reference to the data buffer of the segment, either read-write or read-only.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the codeblock.
